guarantees.claim: adv_matrix[Creator] is always assigned AdvDataWidth'({sw_binding, otp_device_id_i, lc_keymgr_div_i, rom_digest_i.data, revision_seed}).
adv_dvalid[Creator] is always assigned creator_seed_vld & devid_vld & health_state_vld & rom_digest_vld.
owner_seed is driven by otp_key_i.owner_seed if UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true; otherwise it is driven by flash_i.seeds[flash_ctrl_pkg::OwnerSeedIdx].
adv_matrix[OwnerInt] is always assigned AdvDataWidth'({sw_binding, creator_seed}).
adv_matrix[Owner] is always assigned AdvDataWidth'({sw_binding, owner_seed}).

assumptions.claim: Data signals used in adv_matrix[Creator] (otp_device_id_i, lc_keymgr_div_i, rom_digest_i.data, revision_seed) are stable and valid when the corresponding valid signals (devid_vld, health_state_vld, rom_digest_vld) are asserted.
assumptions.cond: when any of the constituent valid signals are high
assumptions.risk: If data changes while valid is high, adv_matrix captures corrupted values, leading to incorrect key derivation for Creator.

assumptions.claim: When UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is true, otp_key_i.owner_seed is valid and stable before it is used as owner_seed for Owner adv_matrix.
assumptions.risk: An invalid or stale owner_seed would compromise the derived owner key, as adv_dvalid[Owner] is always 1.

assumptions.claim: When UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash is false, flash_i.seeds[flash_ctrl_pkg::OwnerSeedIdx] provides a correct and valid seed.
assumptions.risk: If the flash seed is not valid, the owner key derivation will use garbage, as adv_dvalid[Owner] is always 1.

uncertain_points.claim: adv_matrix[OwnerInt] data uses creator_seed, but its valid signal (adv_dvalid[OwnerInt]) is owner_seed_vld, not a validity related to creator_seed. This mismatch may cause the state machine to be gated by an unrelated seed validity.
uncertain_points.cond: when the state machine evaluates adv_dvalid[OwnerInt]
uncertain_points.risk: The OwnerInt advance could be asserted before creator_seed is stable, or stalled despite a valid creator_seed, leading to incorrect intermediate key derivation.

uncertain_points.claim: adv_dvalid[Owner] is tied high independently of the validity of owner_seed. The chunk does not check any validity signal for the seed before allowing Owner advance.
uncertain_points.risk: If owner_seed is invalid or not yet provisioned, the owner key derivation will proceed with garbage, potentially producing a weak or known key.

uncertain_points.claim: The selection of owner_seed source relies on UseOtpSeedsInsteadOfFlash, but this block does not verify that the chosen seed (otp_key_i.owner_seed or flash_i.seeds) is available and non-trash at the moment the keymgr state machine reads Owner adv_matrix.
uncertain_points.cond: when keymgr state machine is ready to advance to Owner
uncertain_points.risk: If the external seed provisioning is misaligned, the owner key derivation could use a default or uninitialized seed, undermining key integrity.

uncertain_points.claim: The signal unused_owner_seed is assigned but never used in the design. It may be intended to prevent optimization of the referenced signals (flash_i.seeds, otp_key_i.owner_seed_valid), which could hint at a missing functional dependency.
uncertain_points.risk: If the signal is truly dead, it wastes resources; if it was meant to gate something, the design may have a correctness gap.
